title: 40 Deliciously Easy Make-Ahead Breakfasts for Christmas Morning
summary: Depending on how you celebrate, Christmas morning might mean presents to open, church services to attend, or family to visit. Whatever it means for you, making a big-batch breakfast ahead of time comes in clutch (especially if you’re planning on cooking a special dinner later in the day). Whether you prefer sweet or savory (or both!), we’ve rounded up some of our absolute favorite Christmas morning breakfasts. And the best part is, they all can be made in advance. READ MORE...
